description: This Java class is a command handler for unassigning staff from a group or center within the Fineract project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and delegates the unassignment operation to GroupingTypesWritePlatformService.

classes.name: UnassignStaffFromCenterCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles the command to unassign staff from a group or center, orchestrating the call to the grouping service.

methods.name: UnassignStaffFromCenterCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the GroupingTypesWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the command to unassign staff, calling the write platform service to perform the operation.
